elementName: The night the beacon went dark

bibleState.what_happens: Before the book opens, the keeper of the signal tower lets the beacon go dark on the night the supply fleet is due. Three ships run onto the reef below the tower, and the keeper is found asleep at the foot of the stair.
bibleState.consequences: The keeper is stripped of his post and leaves the island within the month. The islanders stop trusting the beacon and keep their own watch on the cliff, a habit that holds through the whole book and that the protagonist grows up inside.
